comment: rig-radar HITL catalog. One COMPOSITE unit 'radar-bench' reserved atomically: the ESP32-C6 radar host (flash + RISC-V JTAG via its built-in USB-JTAG) AND the RP2350 CMSIS-DAP probe wired to the Rd-03E's GD32E230 (SWD). Both are USB; /dev/bus/usb is passed so pyOCD/openocd can do raw USB. FILL IN the two by-id device paths + the C6's USB-JTAG serial (MAC) from the Pi: `ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/`. The toolbox in the reservation env (nix/container.nix) provides: C6 -> hitl-flash/hitl-monitor/hitl-jtag/hitl-gdb; GD32 -> hitl-swd (pyocd gdbserver, GD32 pack baked in)/hitl-swd-dump.

components.name: c6
components.comment: ESP32-C6 radar host. USB-JTAG serial (its MAC) read from the rig 2026-11-10: 98:88:E0:71:08:10 (303a:1001, native USB-Serial-JTAG).

components.name: gd32-probe
components.comment: RP2350 (Pico 2) running stock debugprobe (fughilli/rp2350-swd-probe), SWD to the Rd-03E GD32E230. Real by-id from the rig 2026-11-10: a Pico running debugprobe enumerates as 'Debugprobe_on_Pico' and exposes only its CDC-ACM UART as a tty (-if01); the CMSIS-DAP interface is raw-USB (pyOCD finds it by serial over /dev/bus/usb).

units.comment: The radar bench: C6 + GD32 SWD probe, reserved together. Capabilities = union of both components.
units.name: radar-bench
